title: Bleep Wall-Node -> Dashboard Telemetry Message
description: One JSON object per HTTP POST (or same-shape in-memory record, in the peer-to-peer wall_node.ino path) from a wall (anchor) node to the dashboard. Envelope fields are always present; 'payload' shape depends on msgType. Covers fall/inactivity detection plus environmental and vitals hazard sensing (DHT11, BMP180, MQ-135, MQ-4, MAX30102, soil moisture) — extend msgType/payload as later features are added, don't redesign the envelope.

schemaVersion.description: Bump this when the SHAPE of any payload changes (new required field, renamed field). Lets the dashboard reject or adapt to messages from older firmware instead of silently misreading them.

msgType.description: STATUS = routine periodic update (recommended addition, ~every 2s). DISTRESS = fall/inactivity event, sent once immediately on trigger, not on the next scheduled tick.

workerId.description: Hardcoded per worker device, e.g. 'W1'. Must match the ID the worker ESP32 puts in its ESP-NOW packet to the wall node.

nodeId.description: ID of the WALL node relaying this message. Not useful with only one wall node yet, but free to add now so nothing needs restructuring when you add a second.

seq.description: Increments per message FROM THIS WORKER (not per wall node). Lets the dashboard detect dropped, duplicated, or out-of-order deliveries over WiFi.

espnowRssi.description: Signal strength (dBm) of the last ESP-NOW packet the wall node received from this worker. Send null if your firmware isn't reading this yet — do not omit the field.

timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the WALL node booted (millis()). This is NOT wall-clock time. The dashboard should stamp its own arrival time on receipt for anything it displays or logs — see the protocol notes.

environmentalFields.description: Sent on every STATUS and DISTRESS message regardless of hazard type, so the dashboard always has live gauge data. 0 (or null for temperatureC/humidityPct/pressureHPa) means 'no reading yet' — sensor not wired up, or MAX30102 with no finger/skin contact — never a real measurement.

airQualityRaw.description: MQ-135 raw ADC reading (0-4095), toxic/air-quality gas. Not a calibrated ppm value — needs on-site calibration.

combustibleGasRaw.description: MQ-4 raw ADC reading (0-4095), combustible gas (methane/LPG). Not a calibrated ppm value.

heartRateBpm.description: MAX30102-derived heart rate. 0 means no finger/skin contact, not a flatline.

spo2Pct.description: MAX30102-derived SpO2 estimate (ratio-of-ratios approximation, not medical-grade). 0 means no reading available.

soilMoisturePct.description: Soil/floor moisture sensor, 0-100%, used as a water-ingress/flooding proxy.

riskState.description: Treat as an open string on the dashboard, not a fixed set — currently 'OK' for STATUS. Don't hardcode a switch statement that breaks on an unrecognized value.

motionEnergy.description: Current rolling motion-energy value from the worker's MPU6050 loop, same units as used for the inactivity threshold in firmware.

secondsSinceMotion.description: How long the inactivity timer has been running without a reset.

battery.description: Reserved for when battery monitoring is added (see the build checklist's 'other basic features'). Always send null until then — keep the field present so the dashboard doesn't need a schema change later.

hazardType.description: Keep this an open string on the dashboard side, same reasoning as riskState — new hazard types can be added without a dashboard code change.

riskState.description: Mirrors the worker's local state at the moment of trigger — one of SOS, INACTIVITY, HEAT_STRESS, GAS_DANGER, HIGH_HEART_RATE, LOW_HEART_RATE, LOW_SPO2, WATER_INGRESS, or FALL_SUSPECTED, matching hazardType above (GAS_DANGER covers both TOXIC_GAS and COMBUSTIBLE_GAS hazardTypes).

secondsInactive.description: How long the inactivity timer had run when it crossed INACTIVITY_DURATION_SEC. Only meaningful for FALL_SUSPECTED/INACTIVITY hazardTypes; still sent (as elapsed time since last motion) for every other hazard type, since the field is always present in the wire packet.

motionEnergyAtTrigger.description: The motion-energy value at the instant of triggering, for debugging false positives/negatives.
